blocks.content: Quiz: When does useMemo() recompute its value?
Tap an option below to answer:
On every render, the same as regular code in the component body
That would defeat the purpose since useMemo() exists precisely to avoid recomputing on every render.
That would defeat the purpose since useMemo() exists precisely to avoid recomputing on every render.
useMemo() depends on its own dependency array, not on the parent's render cycle.
useMemo() depends on its own dependency array, not on the parent's render cycle.
Only when one of the values in its dependency array has changed
React caches the result and only calls the function again when a dependency has changed.
React caches the result and only calls the function again when a dependency has changed.
Only once, when the component first mounts
useMemo() reruns whenever a dependency changes — not only on mount.
useMemo() reruns whenever a dependency changes — not only on mount.
